LanguageData.RatkinTunnel_Guerrilla.label: tunnel invasion
LanguageData.RatkinTunnel_Guerrilla.letterText: Earthquake waves were detected.\n\nA special ratkin unit trained by will soon come up from the ground. We have to stop them before they paralyze the facility.
LanguageData.RatkinFollowUpTroops.label: follow-up unit
LanguageData.RatkinFollowUpTroops.letterText: EMP explosion, waiting outside, came in.\n\nWe need to prepare for the defense.
LanguageData.RK_Incident_VagabondJoin.label: wanderers join
LanguageData.RK_Incident_VagabondJoin.letterText: At a moment of crisis, two wanderers have appeared. Can they change your fate?
LanguageData.RK_Incident_PriestJoin.label: priest joins
LanguageData.RK_Incident_PriestJoin.letterText: Priest [PAWN_nameDef] wants to join your settlement.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] is deeply faithful and has a healing touch.
LanguageData.RK_Incident_WanderingTrader.label: wandering trader arrives
